guard: mesh-side persona catalog details ride owner-or-admin; a foreign card is name-only
why: THE DEFECT IS A MISSING READ, AND THE DANGEROUS HALF OF THE READ IS OWNERSHIP.
A catalog that always attaches role/model/description would let any spawn-capable peer
read a prompt it cannot redefine. The unique code-only cell is personaCatalogReadable's
owner-or-admin predicate in packages/core/src/agent-file.ts; the manager handler calls
that function, and this suite inlines the same projection so a always-true mutation
leaks aliceTheirs.description and a never-non-admin mutation hides aliceMine.role.
No broker: the suite writes a throwaway .cotal/agents tree and grades the helpers
the manager consults. ci-suites.txt is frozen; this fixture is the proof path.

mutations.cell: alice sees a foreign name only — no role, model, or description leak
mutations.name: catalog details become readable to every caller (always-true)
mutations.expectRed: alice sees a foreign name only

mutations.name: catalog details become admin-only (owner cannot read own card)
